description.value: You give your pawns an additional means of attack. When you install this Schematic on a pawn, choose one of the following Strikes for it to gain, along with that Strike's damage type: a melee unarmed Strike that deals 1d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage (brawling group; finesse, unarmed), or a ranged unarmed Strike that deals 1d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage with a range increment of 20 feet (sling group; unarmed).
